vm_stat_partial.note: swapins/swapouts not captured pre-run; using Run 25 post values as proxy baseline (idle gap with no significant activity)

deltas.note: Run 26 had ~40% more compressions than Run 25 and was 78% slower. Compressor CPU work blocks Metal allocations under unified-memory contention.

load_avg_contamination_check.interpretation: PRE-run load was clean (well under 4.0 threshold). POST-run spike to 6.38 includes the benchmark wind-down + page compressor catching up on 48M pending operations. The run itself is NOT contaminated — Run 26's high swap I/O rate (467 MB/s) is within 10% of the 369-448 MB/s observed in prior runs, so it's not 'compressed harder per second', just 'compressed for longer'.

four_run_summary.interpretation: N=4 reveals per-task bimodal timing (NIAH and RULER 16K k=5 each independently distribute as ~70s OR ~250s, ~3.3x ratio). Worst case (Run 26) draws slow on both. Runtime CV jumped from 14% (N=3) to 22% (N=4). Need N>=16 to detect 10% regressions.

headline_finding: PER-TASK BIMODAL TIMING DISTRIBUTION — Phase 3 NIAH and RULER 16K keys=5 each independently land in ~70s or ~250s mode (3.3x ratio), with no system-state correlation visible. Run 26 happened to draw slow on both.
